 Stephen Curry makes Luka Doncic hit the floor with nasty crossover play 
 2026-10-31 04:09 
 Stephen Curry dropped Luka Doncic on the floor with a series of dazzling dribbling moves before sinking a three-pointer in one of the best highlights to start the 2026-27 NBA season.
 Credit: Getty Images via AFP - Scanpix 
 Credit Getty Images via AFP - Scanpix 
 Credit Getty Images via AFP - Scanpix 
 Add us on 
 Add us on 
 Stephen Curry added another victim to his list with his incredible ball-handling wizardry and dribbling skills, this time leaving Luka Doncic on the floor.
 Stephen Curry

 With six minutes remaining in the third quarter of the Los Angeles Lakers-Golden State Warriors NBA Cup opener, Curry delivered one of the best highlights of the early 2026-27 season by dropping Doncic.
 After a series of dribbling moves, Curry sent Doncic off balance and eventually to the floor before knocking down a three-pointer.
 Even Curry couldn't hide his amazement, holding his hands to his head after the jaw-dropping play.
 After trailing by as many as 25 points, Curry and the Warriors outlasted the Lakers in an epic comeback by securing a 112-95 win.
 Curry finished with 31 points, six assists, and four rebounds, draining six triples. Doncic dropped 37 to lead the Lakers' losing effort.
